translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Boas Yrlztile Rut

Mz nourla lcde, Boas vz mz naobz ngr taon lc x sc tqwxbupe elr, murde krlc me nzatubqtingr lrtzlvz ngrdr da. X kxnginide kc tqesotr-zlwzbz, krkc tqpibzle mz Rut, sc tqmcpele nzvz-krde. X sc tqkqlepxpele nzrpi-krbzle kx, “Vz-kaip mrka, kx mzlenge, x wxbu kai mrlc.” Ncblo kc vzbz, sc tqwxbupe.
Zbz Boas kapxmle lrtzlvz nzpnu-esz' kx nzmncng mrlcde. X rpibzle badr kx, “Nawxbuku ena x okatrpa'mu nigr.”
Zbz Boas sc tqrpipebzle mz mzlede lc kx, “Naomi kc tqyzlupem Moab, sc tqamwale drtc' nyz mzlegu Elimelek.

Vzdzm mz drtwrnge nzpi-krbole bam. Kx tqsuti drtwrm nzxpengr drtc' lc, e xpe mzli ka tzmncngr lrtzlvz ngrgu lcng, badr mrlx lcng. Kx tqsuti drtwrm naxpepxqle murde nayzlu-mop mz nqvi lrgu, ale. A' nzmu kx trtingrde, pim bange, murde trpnzngr kx takitrde nzxpepxngr drtc' lc, a' nim txpwz, x krali ninge.” X ayzlubzle natqde kx, “Sa naxpepxbo.”
Rpi-mopwz Boas kx, “Mzli kc naxpepx-ngrbzme drtc' lc mz Naomi, yrlzti kz Rut kc Moab, olvz r mzlegu kc tqbz. Murde mrlxmu ncdr Rut kalr nalolvzle drtc' nyz Malon kc tqbz x nqvi lrde bzkq mztr.”
Rpibz mzlede lc kx, “Mz nzmu-krde lcde, trpengr nzxpepx-krnge drtc' lc, murde ma tqamnctxpxle ninge x trpnzngr da kx na-aprcbo mz mrlxngeng. A' xpepxpe, murde trtakitrpepleu ninge.”

X sc tqkapxpele sadol scde tqkapebzle mz Boas. Murde mzli kc tqprtzngr da lc, nqmq kr lr Israel mz nzxpepxngr x nzaprcngr dztu, kxmule sele. Kzdq ncblo nzmu kapxle sadol scde x kabzle mz mrlx kztede, aelwapx-ngrde kx drtwrdr rlilrdr esz'ti mz nike nzaolvzlr.

Boas sc tqycmnepebz mz lrtzlvz x leplz kcng mrkc, mz nzrpi-krbzle kx, “Mzbq ka mcpeamu x xlrpeamu kx sa naxpepxbo mz Naomi drtc' nyz Elimelek kc tqbzszbzle mz mrlxdeng Kilion x Malon, kcng tzbzpe-kzng.

X nayrlzti-kzx Rut kc Moab tqbzsz Malon, nangi olvz rnge. Murde mrlxgr kc kai ncdr Rut kalr nalolvzle drtc' nyz Malon x nqvi lrde bzkq mztr, a' drtqde nadcpxpwz mz mztea nyzgu. Mzbq ka sc tqmc-lxblrpeamu.”

Zbz lrtzlvz x leplz amrlx kcng tzmncng mz naobz nzrpibzlr kx, “Eu, sc tqmc-lxblrpekr. X krka'-ngrgr kx Yawe nangi-batrpzle mz olvz kc nayrlztiq nzrngine-krde doa kxkqlu mz nzapu-krde Resel x Lea kcng tzakqlunepxlr lr Israel. X nanginim bcnyr x namatq-esz'-ngrn Betleem.
X krka'-kz-ngrgr kx doa kx nakabz Yawe bam, navzpxmqng mz olvz lc, nakqlu-zlwzng na-apule doa neng melrmqgu Peres, mrlx Judz badr Tama, lr mrkzble.”
Boas X Rut Nzrngineng Doa Ncblo
Zbz Boas sc tqyrlztipele Rut. Nzmwi-lxblrng x okatr Yawe nidr mz nzyrkr Rut. X rmika nede doa ncblo.
Nzrpibz olvz kcng tzmncng mrkc mz blrkq mrlx Rut kx, “Naomi, takitrde nzrglqlzngr Yawe, murde rkabz nem doa ncblo mzbq ka. Krka'-ngrgr kx doa lc nakrlzti lr Israel nide.

X rlxtibzkr mz Yawe kx doa ncblo lc na-aelalzmle drtwrm x naokatrle nim mzli ka nzngini-krm blang. Murde lvxbqm, kc tqmrlzti-zlwzle nim mikale nide. X kxmule-esz' narnginem doa ncblo kxnzkqlung, a' nzokatr-krdr nim trmyaszpxleu nzokatrkr Rut lc nim.”
Naomi brlcle doa kc. Zbz sc tqokatrpele Rut nzabutingr.
Olvz lr Betleem nzrpilr kx, “Naomi nepede kc doa ncblo.” X nzyrlqbzlr drtqde Obed. Obed lc nide kc tqngi trte Jesi kc tqngi trte King Devet.
Nqvi Lr Boas
Krlc nqvi lr ncblo kx vzpxm mz Peres. Peres mrlxde Hesron.
Hesron mrlxde Ram, Ram mrlxde Aminadab.
Aminadab mrlxde Nason, Nason mrlxde Salmon.
Salmon mrlxde Boas, Boas mrlxde Obed.
Obed mrlxde Jesi x Jesi mrlxde Devet.

footnotes.text: Kxmule-esz' naxpepxle drtc' lc, a' trpnzngr nzvztr-krdele o nzaprc-krbzlele mz mrlxdeng mz olvz rde kc kai.

Mz nzvz-nqblq-krdr nqmq kr lr Israel, doa ncblo kx vzpxm mz nzyrlzngr kxmule lc, trtede li. Nide mrlx ncblo kc tqbzsz lxede, x ni-kzde mrlx ncblo kc tqyrlzti-atele. Murde mz Rut 4:11-12 rpile kx doa ncblo lc nanginide mrlx Boas. A' mz 4:18-22, prtr mz nqvi lr Malon nide mz Elimelek. Mc kz Nou dckrlzde kc 38, 46:12 x Matiu 1:2 kc tzycmnetr-ngrdr doa ncblo ne Tama kcng tzlipxmqng nzngini-krdr mrlx Judz.
